$comment: The fourteen demo cases of the reinsurance desk: four bordereaux and ten recovery cases (nine paid claims, each a case of its own, and the two paid claims of one event in one case). The desk lists the newest case first, so the file is written last to first. Everything is invented: Thornmere Mutual Insurance, its coverholders, its reinsurers, its binders and treaties and the insured. Every id, date and amount is what the invented insurer returns when it is started with the date 26 November 2026.

Row 7: TMI-EN-0307, Northgate Bakeries. Ovens and dough mixers at two bakeries, installed 2022. Port Ilvane, Meridia. Starts 22 Oct 2026. Sum insured USD 650,000.00; ceded USD 260,000.00; ceded premium USD 1,400.00; ceding commission USD 420.00; net ceded premium USD 980.00

Row 8: TMI-EN-0308, Sorrel Valley Bottlers. Filling and labelling machines, installed 2021. Marlow Reach, Meridia. Starts 28 Oct 2026. Sum insured USD 1,800,000.00; ceded USD 720,000.00; ceded premium USD 3,600.00; ceding commission USD 1,080.00; net ceded premium USD 2,520.00
THE AGENT'S TASK
The agent sets every row against the numbered terms of the binder or treaty and lists the differences. The reinsurance system measures every figure and every date and adds the totals again. The agent reads the description of each risk against the excluded risks. It rejects no bordereau, changes no figure and writes to nobody. The reinsurance accountant decides what is queried with the sender. Everything here is as the reinsurance system holds it. The agent reads the bordereau itself from the reinsurance system.
